rows.ja: 技術・導入パートナー
顧客(nCinoの年次報告に記載)

relations.text: nCinoのプラットフォームに連携する技術パートナーとしてAnthropicを挙げている
relations.text_en: Anthropic is named among technology partners integrated within the nCino Platform

source.label: nCino 10-K
source.quote: Utilizing the open architecture of the nCino Platform, an increasing number of technology partners, including Anthropic, AWS, Databricks, Salesforce, Rich Data Co, Alloy, Plaid, and Docusign, are integrated within our Platform.

relations.text: Salesforceが競合する自社製品を開発する可能性を、年次報告が挙げている
relations.text_en: The annual report notes Salesforce could develop its own offerings that compete directly

source.label: nCino 10-K
source.quote: Furthermore, there are no exclusivity arrangements in place with Salesforce that would prevent them from developing their own offerings that compete directly with ours, acquiring a company with offerings similar to ours, or investing greater resources in our competitors.
source.note: 競合の可能性への言及です。

relations.text: 販売・導入を支援するパートナーとしてAccentureを挙げている
relations.text_en: Accenture is named among partners that assist in co-selling and implementation

source.label: nCino 10-K
source.quote: These partners (including Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, and West Monroe Partners, among others) assist in prospecting, marketing, co-selling, product evaluation/feedback, and implementation of our solutions and have helped support our new market and global expansion.

relations.text: 大手金融機関顧客向けの導入・設定にAccentureなどのSIを活用している
relations.text_en: nCino uses SIs including Accenture to implement and configure the platform for larger FI customers

source.label: nCino 10-K
source.quote: We also leverage the services of SIs, including Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, and West Monroe Partners, among others, to implement and configure the nCino Platform for our larger FI customers, while we have historically performed professional services for smaller FIs ourselves.

relations.text: 顧客の例としてWells Fargoが挙げられている
relations.text_en: Wells Fargo is named among nCino's customers

source.label: nCino 10-K
source.quote: Our diverse customer base ranges from global FIs, such as Wells Fargo, Bank of America, Barclays, Santander, and TD Bank; to enterprise banks, such as Truist Bank and U.S.

relations.text: 2026年3月31日に、Wells Fargo Bank, N.A.と1億ドルの自己株式取得(ASR)契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: On March 31, 2026 nCino entered into a $100.0 million Accelerated Share Repurchase agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, N.A.

source.label: nCino 10-K
source.quote: On March 31, 2026, the Company entered into an Accelerated Share Repurchase (“ASR”) agreement with Wells Fargo Bank, N.A., authorized by the Board of Directors, for $ 100.0 million.
source.note: 株式買戻しの相手方としての関係です。

relations.text: Q2 Holdingsの年次報告が、エヌシーノを競合として挙げている
relations.text_en: Names nCino as a competitor in its annual report

source.label: Q2 Holdings 10-K
source.quote: With respect to our digital lending and relationship pricing solutions, we compete against several point system competitors, including Abrigo, Baker Hill Solutions, nCino, Finastra, Brilliance Financial Technology, Temenos AG, and core processing vendors, including FIS and Fiserv.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
